name: Archosauria
blurb: Crocodiles and birds: the surviving members of the lineage that also produced pterosaurs and the non-avian dinosaurs.

clock.method: Bayesian relaxed molecular clock (PhyloBayes, CAT-GTR), calibration scheme C16; mean and conservative 95% credibility interval (extremes of the 95% CIs of 100 gene-jackknife timetrees)
clock.checked: Irisarri et al. 2017, Supplementary Table 9, node 109 ("Archosaurians (Archosauria)")
